mapper.select: select * from rm_user_t where deleted = 0 and lower(user_name) = lower(#{userName}) limit 1

select u.* from rm_user_t u where u.id = #{userId} and u.deleted = 0 and exists ( select 1 from rm_user_tenant_rela_t utr where utr.user_id = u.id and utr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and utr.status = 1 and utr.is_del = 0 ) limit 1
